name: StatGroup
description: Mortar marketing stat group, using central semantic tokens.

props.label: string
props.items: { value: string; label: string; description?: string }[]
props.id: string (the root element's id, e.g. an in-page link target)
props.className: string (layout only: margins or grid placement)
props.layout: "grid" | "timeline" | "stepped" (default grid). timeline: a dotted line through dated milestones (value is the date). stepped: cards that rise in height
props.background: ReactNode (decorative full-cover image; switches to the inverse tone with a scrim)

contract.usage: Import { StatGroup } from @tony-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states. The root element exposes data-m-component for tests and consumers. It is not a styling hook.
